desc: Reduce operation sequences to selecting type-1 intervals and type-2 complements, noting that operation order is irrelevant.
Establish that three or more type-2 intervals can be reduced to at most two, including empty intersections.

Audit the extremal-pair reduction: the globally maximum-left/minimum-right pair has an intersection contained in every pair intersection, and the original pair's intervals remain available as type-1 intervals, so it is never worse.
Run exhaustive semantic validation against brute force for small \(N\) and \(M\), comparing feasibility, achieved final state, and minimum cost rather than exact output vectors.
Audit candidate-cost evaluation, compressed-state transitions, forbidden-interval handling, reconstruction, duplicate-operation selection, impossible cases, and boundary conditions.
If semantic validation finds a genuine counterexample, identify the faulty component and replace or repair that component.
